title: BANO PICHLE PAHAR ASGHAR KE LIYE ROTI HAI
body:
bano pichle pahar asghar ke liye roti hai
ek wo jaagti hai qalq-e- khuda soti hai
sar ko bhi peet-ti hai jaan ko bhi khoti hai
ye ajab gham hai ke taskeen nahi hoti hai
<<MINI>>
peet'te peetite behosh jo hojaati hai
ali asghar ali asghar ki sadaa aati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi kone me wo mu dhaamp ke chillati hai aur kabhi sahen me ghabraake nikal aati hai
kookh pakde huwe har ek taraf jaati hai
dhoondti hai magar asghar ko nahi paati hai
tan ko larzish hai juda aur hai mu zard juda
dil tadapta hai juda seene me hai dard juda
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi kehti hai ke ghar me mere andhiyaara hai
ali asghar ki judaayi ne mujhe maara hai
haaye main ghar me hoon jungle me mera pyaara hai
meherbaani jo kare mout to chut'kaara hai
<<MINI>>
kab talak raato'n ko ham nala-o faryaad kare'n
ya ilaahi ali asghar mujhe ab yaad kare'n
<<DIVIDER>>
god phailaake kabhi kehti hai dilbar aaja
rooh be-chain hai aaja ali asghar aaja
dil tadapta hai mera god ke andar aaja
fatema ke liye aaja paye hyder aaja
<<MINI>>
boond paani ke liye haaye teri jaan gayi
aa mai sadqe gayi waari gayi qurbaan gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
aake seene se mere seena lagado beta
aag bhadki hai kaleje me bujhaado beta
qushk mu apna mere mu se mila do beta
ek nazar chand si tasveer dikhado beta
<<MINI>>
jaao phir quld me maa tumko na behlaayegi
ek dam se na ziyada tumhe tahraayegi
<<DIVIDER>>
loriyaa'n hum tumhe aye laal diya karte the
aap lete huwe jhule me hasa karte the
ghutniyou'n ghutniyou'n gar aap chala karte the
kurta pakde huwe ham saath raha karte the
<<MINI>>
haaye maa baap se qismat ne chudhaya tumko
soone jangal me meri jaan sulaya tumko
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad har cheez teri aati hai aye nek qisaal
meri nazro'n ke tale phirti hai wo teri chaal
juti juti wo bhawe'n aur jhandoole wo baal
choti choti wo teri ungliyaa'n aye mere laal
<<MINI>>
bu-e gul aati thi beta tere pairaahan me
qoob khilti thi ali band teri gardan me
<<DIVIDER>>
qalq sab soti hai raato ko gharou me apne
ham agar lete hai karwat to qasam lo hamse
neend aati mere pahlu me agar tum hote
tum to aye laqte jigar god me marqad ke gaye
<<MINI>>
yaad is paalne waali ki bhulaayi tumne
paayenti baap ki aye laal basaayi tumne
<<DIVIDER>>
haaye asghar na tera dain huwa maa se adaa
bojh koi meri gardan se na utraa tera
naa teri saalgiraah ki, na tera doodh baddha
naa lahad tujh ko mili aur na kafan tujh ko mila
<<MINI>>
tum to maare gaye chaati pa litaau'n kisko
chote chote ye shalooke mai pahanaoo'n kisko
<<DIVIDER>>
bain karti thi yeh sar peet ke bano dukhya
aage is tarha se hai raavi-e pur gham likkha
aayi ek simt se waa'n peetne rone ki sadaa
har taraf bano-e- bekas ne ba hasrat dekha
<<MINI>>
roke kehne lagi maaloom nahi hota hai
koi baitha huwa hamraah mere rota hai
<<DIVIDER>>
koun hai meri tarha dukh me phasa aye daawar
koun bekas hai meri tarha se rota aakar
ye wo kehti thi ke ye aayi sadaa us jaa par
aye bahu quld se aaya hai yahaan paighambar
<<MINI>>
tere rone ne aziyyat mujhe pahonchayi hai
qabr se aah teri mujh ko uthaa laayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ghash me bano ne jo ye fatema zehra se suna
haath phaila diye aur god me asghar ko liya
mu se mu uske mala aur labou ko chooma
qoob lipta ke kaleje se ye roro ke kaha
<<MINI>>
thi judaayi ne teri, aag lagaayi beta
tum ne wo aag mere dil ki bujhaayi beta
